The Director General of the Arewa for Asiwaju, Alhaji Muhammadu Badaru Abubakar, on Wednesday in Kano unveiled 528 Kano Youths Ambassadors, predicting that the North will shower massive votes for President Tinubu in 2027. Speaking at the event, Badaru Abubakar, a former Minister of Defence and also former Governor of Jigawa State, said the youths were expected to visit the nooks and crannies of the 44 local government areas of the state to “spread the gospel of good works” of President Bola Tinubu ahead of the 2027 general elections. “The job of the 528 Youth Ambassadors is to go out to the nooks and crannies of the 484 wards of the 44 local government areas of the state to spread the gospel of good works of President Tinubu, which is clearly not propaganda,” he said He noted that youths are the bedrock of any clear road to victory, stressing that their open acceptance and participation at the event clearly indicate that Tinubu’s victory in 2027 is a foregone conclusion. He said, “The happy hundreds of youths that came out for this programme give us much higher hopes, apart from the fact that we knew that even before this time, the North stood firmly with the President”. The former Defence Minister explained that the Abuja chapter of the Arewa for Asiwaju (A4A) and other liaison offices across the country would soon be inaugurated. Also speaking at the event, the A4A State Coordinator and former Minister of State for Housing, Abdullahi Tijjani Muhammad Gwarzo, explained that the selection of the Youth was done carefully to ensure that youths of proven integrity are on board for the campaign to re-elect President Tinubu. Gwarzo noted that projects that spread across the Northern region are going to be pick-pointed and shown to every discerning voice that the President deserves the region’s massive votes. “These Ambassadors are going to have other supporting agents at every ward who will now guard polling units to ensure that what was given to our President is what we get; doing this will further ensure sanity in the elections”. Alhaji Muhammadu Badaru Abubakar explained that soon they are going to inaugurate Abuja A4A and other liaison offices across the Federation. Tukur Muntari
